live.instructions: Linkly is a link-management and analytics platform. Use these tools to create, update, search, and delete short links; manage custom domains and favicons; configure click webhooks; and read click analytics and exports for the authenticated user's workspace. All actions run against the current OAuth-authenticated workspace (see list_workspaces). Find a link's id with search_links or list_links before calling get_link, update_link, or delete_link.

tools.name: test_authentication
tools.description: Test API Authentication

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: Return details of authenticated workspace

tools.name: batchDeleteLinks
tools.description: Batch delete multiple links

ids.description: Array of link IDs to delete

tools.name: update_workspace
tools.description: Update workspace settings. Only the fields provided are changed; omitted fields keep their current values.

webhooks.description: REPLACES the workspace's full webhook subscription list. Omit to leave webhooks unchanged; prefer subscribe_webhook / unsubscribe_webhook for adding or removing a single URL.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List links with sorting and search

items.description: A Linkly link (mirrors the OpenAPI Link schema)

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Health check

message.description: a message to ping , default to Hello From Linkkly

tools.name: create_link
tools.description: Create short links and URL shorteners. Use this when the user asks to shorten a URL, create a short link, or make a link shorter.

url.description: The destination URL for the link (required)

name.description: A nickname for the link to identify it later

note.description: A private note about this link

domain.description: Custom domain for the short link (without trailing /). Must be a domain that already belongs to this workspace — call list_domains to get valid values. Required whenever slug is set.

slug.description: Custom slug/suffix for the link (must start with /). Only valid together with domain: setting slug without a workspace-owned domain is rejected by the API.

enabled.description: Whether the link is active (default: true)

og_title.description: Open Graph title for social media previews

og_description.description: Open Graph description for social media previews

og_image.description: Open Graph image URL for social media previews

cloaking.description: Hide destination URL by opening in an iframe

forward_params.description: Forward URL parameters to the destination

block_bots.description: Block known bots and spiders from following the link

hide_referrer.description: Hide referrer information when users click

expiry_datetime.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the link should expire

expiry_destination.description: Fallback URL after expiry (404 if blank)

outputSchema.description: A Linkly link (mirrors the OpenAPI Link schema)

tools.name: update_link
tools.description: Update an existing Linkly link by its ID

link_id.description: The ID of the link to update (required)

outputSchema.description: A Linkly link (mirrors the OpenAPI Link schema)

tools.name: delete_link
tools.description: Delete a Linkly link by its ID

link_id.description: The ID of the link to delete

tools.name: get_link
tools.description: Get details of a specific Linkly link by its ID

link_id.description: The ID of the link to retrieve

outputSchema.description: A Linkly link (mirrors the OpenAPI Link schema)

tools.name: get_clicks
tools.description: Get recent click data for the workspace

link_id.description: Optional: filter clicks by link ID

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Get time-series click analytics data for charting. Returns click counts over time.

start.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: 30 days ago)

end.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today)

bots.description: Bot filtering: include (default), exclude, or only

tools.name: get_analytics_by
tools.description: Get click counts grouped by a dimension (country, platform, referrer, etc.). Useful for breakdowns and top-N reports.

start.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: 30 days ago)

end.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today)

tools.name: export_clicks
tools.description: Export detailed click records with full information (timestamp, browser, country, URL, platform, referer, bot, ISP, params).

start.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: 30 days ago)

end.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: yesterday)

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List all custom domains in the workspace.

items.description: A custom domain (mirrors the OpenAPI Domain schema)

tools.name: create_domain

outputSchema.description: A custom domain (mirrors the OpenAPI Domain schema)

tools.name: delete_domain
tools.description: Remove a custom domain from the workspace.

domain_id.description: The ID of the domain to delete

tools.name: update_domain_favicon
tools.description: Update the favicon URL for a custom domain.

domain_id.description: The ID of the domain to update

tools.name: search_links
tools.description: Search for links by name, URL, or note. Returns matching links with click statistics.

query.description: Search query to match against link names, URLs, and notes

items.description: A Linkly link (mirrors the OpenAPI Link schema)

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List all webhook URLs subscribed to the workspace. These receive click events for all links.

tools.name: subscribe_webhook
tools.description: Subscribe a webhook URL to receive click events for all links in the workspace.

url.description: The webhook URL to receive click event notifications

tools.name: unsubscribe_webhook
tools.description: Unsubscribe a webhook URL from workspace click events.

tools.name: list_link_webhooks
tools.description: List all webhook URLs subscribed to a specific link.

tools.name: subscribe_link_webhook
tools.description: Subscribe a webhook URL to receive click events for a specific link.

url.description: The webhook URL to receive click event notifications

tools.name: unsubscribe_link_webhook
tools.description: Unsubscribe a webhook URL from a specific link's click events.
